subject: Invoice pulse calendar + triggered top-up for annual prepay (DL-7982)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice pulse calendar + triggered top-up for annual prepay (DL-7982)

Hi Trevor / BrightLane AP team,

Thanks again for agreeing to the annual prepay structure for DL-7982. Attached is a proposed "invoice pulse" calendar (2026_Q3_invoice_pulse.xlsx) that staggers monthly invoices against the committed spend and includes the sweep windows we discussed for unused balance reconciliation. High level: 
- Monthly invoice on the 1st of the month (charges for previous month consumption)
- Quarterly reconciliation snapshot on the 15th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct
- Automated top-up trigger when usage >= 80% of remaining committed balance (see "triggered top-up" section below)

I've also attached the MAP_prepay_terms_v2.pdf with the payment remittance and VAT handling notes. A couple of asks so we can finalize the invoices and remit flow:
1) Confirm the AP contact for wire vs ACH and the exact remittance email for PO/invoice routing.
2) If BrightLane requires EU VAT handling for any subsidiaries, please list the entity and VAT ID so we can issue country-specific invoices (we can handle gross-up/zero-rated where appropriate).
3) Approve the proposed top-up cadence (instant top-up via card/ACH or scheduled invoice top-up). If you prefer card for instant top-ups, we will surface smaller authorization holds; if ACH/wire, we'll send a top-up invoice.

If this looks good I can send a DocuSign for the bank mandate and the first scheduled invoice will be generated on 2026-09-01.

Thanks,
--
Soojin Lee
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: 2026_Q3_invoice_pulse.xlsx (spreadsheet), MAP_prepay_terms_v2.pdf (pdf)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear plan. We like the monthly pulse + quarterly reconciliation approach. Quick answers below and a couple of notes: 

- AP contact: accounts-payable@brightlane.com (use "BrightLane Inc. - AP" in the remit to field).
- Bank details / mandate: I'll sign the DocuSign and return. Prefer ACH for recurring invoices and card for any instant top-ups if you support tokenized card holds.
- VAT: BrightLane EU is a separate entity (BrightLane Europe GmbH), VAT ID DE123456789 — please send EU invoices to eu-ap@brightlane.com.

We're OK with the 80% top-up trigger. One ask: can you cap any single automatic top-up at $150k to avoid large one-off debits to the card? If the remaining headroom requires more than that, we'll accept a scheduled ACH invoice for the remainder.

I'll complete the DocuSign today (bank-mandate-docusign.pdf) and confirm once returned.

Best,
Trevor

+1 on the plan. Confirming ops/tax items and one minor edit to the cadence: 

- Invoice template: approved. We'll include VAT ID in the invoice PDF footer for EU entities and set numbering prefix to BL-DL7982-INV-YYMMNN.
- Rounding: invoices will round to the nearest dollar; the reconciliation snapshot will include cents items and an "adjustment" line on the following month's pulse invoice.
- Top-up logic: documented in attached topup-trigger-logic.md. Short summary: 
  * Trigger when consumption >= 80% of remaining committed balance.
  * Attempt tokenized card authorization up to $150,000.
  * If card authorization fails or required top-up > $150k, auto-create ACH invoice for remainder with 5 business day terms.
  * Send low-balance notification to accounts-payable@brightlane.com at 85% and 95%.

Soojin: once Trevor's DocuSign comes back, queue the first pulse invoice for 2026-09-01 and set up the quarterly reconciliation on 2027-01-15.

Thanks,
